This small maize plot is just a quarter hectare by my house, and I plant it every year like my father did. I use the local maize seed I saved from last harvest — it grew well enough, and I do not trust buying new seed when I do not know how it will do here. I cannot buy a full bag of fertilizer for this small plot, it is too much money and too much for the land, so I put the goat and chicken droppings I collect through the dry season. My wife and my two sons help me clear, plant, and weed, and we do not need to pay anyone for such a small piece.
